title: Reopen the Kitchen
briefing: Nella’s kitchen has lost its water. Get Oru’s welcome record first, then read the shutoff notice at the Commons exchange. Help restore the feed and post the opening hours at the Relay terminal.
completion: The kitchen is open and its hours are posted. Return Oru’s record, then speak to Nella west of the exchange about the repeated bills.

steps.text: Go to the Commons exchange and press E to read the shutoff notice.
steps.voice: Go to the Commons exchange and press E to read the shutoff notice.

steps.text: Restore the kitchen water feed: repair both controls, clear enforcement, and hold the meter.
steps.voice: Restore the kitchen water feed: repair both controls, clear enforcement, and hold the meter.

story.speaker: iri
story.invitation: I’m Iri Vale, by the Commons gate. Six families need a meal, and Nella’s kitchen has lost its water. Come here. I’ll explain the repair.

title: False Freight Charges
briefing: Stallholders are paying freight charges on goods they carry in themselves. Pull the billing record from the Commons exchange for Iri.
completion: The bill names a lift demolished nineteen years ago. Iri circles the contract number and asks for the receipts.

title: Fix the Crossing Timer
briefing: The crossing waits a full minute for a toll payment it can no longer accept. Reset the Relay terminal to a timed pedestrian crossing.
completion: The lights change. A carrier gets her cart across before the next freight convoy.

title: Protect the Resting Courier
briefing: Two audit drones keep tagging a resting courier as abandoned cargo. Disable them before they drag him back to the depot.
completion: The courier sits down again. His lunch is still warm.

title: Survey the Fen Footpath
briefing: Check the water carriers' path at the Fen drawdown gauge, east of Vesper. Iri needs room for relief carts; Mara wants the drilling rigs kept off the reed bank.
completion: The carts will fit without cutting the bank. Iri marks the route, then adds a barrier the concession's rigs cannot clear.

title: Put Copper Walk on the Map
briefing: The route node sends visitors straight past Copper Walk. Its homes are missing from the register. Add the residents' directions at the Relay terminal.
completion: Copper Walk appears on the display. Someone has already submitted a correction for the kitchen entrance.

title: Recover the Handcarts
briefing: Wirejacks are hauling public handcarts into a salvage depot. Disable the collectors so the carriers can take their carts back.
completion: The carts come back with bent handles and most of their wheels. Iri opens the repair rack.

title: Reconnect the Lift Button
briefing: Lift stewards cannot open a service panel without audit drones reporting a fare violation. Clear the drones while they reconnect the middle landing's call button.
completion: The button lights up. A child presses it three times before the steward asks him to stop.

title: Restore Accessible Routes
briefing: Fetch the original access survey from the Public memory archive. The current map routes wheelchairs into stairs and treats reed banks as spare road space.
completion: Iri restores the turning spaces and removes a freight lane to make room. Its operators arrive at the desk with a bill.

title: Remove Delivery Penalties
briefing: The delivery contract fines families when their courier stops to help someone. Post the replacement terms at the Commons exchange: report delays, waive the penalties.
completion: A late parcel arrives with a note explaining the detour. The recipient signs for it and asks whether the other patient is all right.

title: Survey the Forest Detour
briefing: Survey the old service path at Cinderwood's Canopy refuge. It may carry relief carts without cutting through the last living trees.
completion: The detour works, but it takes longer. Carriers raise their prices; Iri revises the food budget.

title: Test Both Lift Stops
briefing: A route has been marked open without testing the lift at the far end. Run a return check at the Relay terminal before anyone follows it.
completion: The cabin is stuck two floors short. Iri cancels the opening and calls the lift crew.

title: Remove the Toll Warden
briefing: A debt warden is enforcing permits from the vanished council. Shut it down so the crossing stewards can remove the old toll schedule.
completion: The barrier is open. The stewards post their maintenance rota on its empty control box.

title: Protect Travel Records
briefing: The traffic archive stores names beside every journey. At the Memory vault, strip personal routes from the public congestion report.
completion: The traffic totals remain. Iri checks that a search for her own journeys returns nothing.

title: Give Stewards Route Access
briefing: The lower-deck stewards will maintain the network if they can control closures and repairs in their districts. Register their compact at the Commons exchange.
completion: Iri hands over the exclusive access key. Copper Walk files its first repair request without going through her.

title: Survey the South Road
briefing: Survey the road beyond the South floodgate. Mark the water stops, shade, and last safe turnback before the pavement gives way to salt.
completion: The route is mapped. A trader at the first water stop has already changed his prices.

title: Update the Salt Beacon
briefing: The Last salt beacon still broadcasts harbor directions. Update it for the dry basin and add a painted route marker for power failures.
completion: The transmitter cuts out halfway through the test. The painted arrow still points home.

title: Map the Steppe Settlement
briefing: Visit the Glassroot soil core north of Vesper. Mark the homes and the well's catchment before the next route survey calls the steppe vacant.
completion: Iri includes the settlement and roots in the map. She refuses a mineral broker's request for the underlying survey.

title: Stop Shelter Tracking
briefing: Audit drones have followed the beacon signal to the roadside shelters. Disable the trackers before they register the shelters as unpaid toll stations.
completion: The shelter beacons stay on. Iri removes the collectors' tracking addresses from the relay list.

title: Publish Outward Routes
briefing: The Last salt beacon only gives directions back to Vesper. Add the outward routes and their current supply limits.
completion: Both directions are listed. The board also says which water stop has run dry.

title: Protect the Water Carriers
briefing: Wirejacks are stripping cooling fins from public water carriers. Clear the collection route before the next shelter delivery.
completion: The carriers leave on time. The recovered fins go into the roadside repair stock.

title: Measure the Longer Water Route
briefing: The short water route cuts through the bank protecting the fen's remaining well. Check the longer path at the drawdown gauge and report its carrying time.
completion: The detour protects the bank but cuts daily deliveries. Iri posts the reduced ration beside the new route.

title: Connect the Roadside Crews
briefing: The Relay terminal rejects basin messages unless the sender owns the surrounding land. Replace the deed check with a local maintenance signature.
completion: The roadside crews connect using their own station records. The first message requests replacement batteries.

title: Defend the Maintenance Records
briefing: Wardens are challenging the roadside crews' maintenance signatures. Disable their relays while the stewards copy the records to independent ledgers.
completion: The copies are safe. A burned relay identifies the next collector in the outer toll chain.

title: Check the Toll Order’s Expiry
briefing: Retrieve the outer toll chain's founding clause from the Public memory archive. Iri thinks its emergency authority expired with the harbor evacuation.
completion: The toll order expired years ago. The water concessions did not. Iri separates the two stacks of contracts.

title: Set Closure Review Dates
briefing: Install an expiry clock at the South floodgate. Every closure must name a steward, give a reason, and set a review date.
completion: The current closure now ends on Friday unless a named steward renews it. The appeal address fits on the same screen.

title: Clear the Emergency Channel
briefing: Fee-notice drones are flooding the basin frequency ahead of a dust front. Shut down the repeaters so distress calls can reach the beacons.
completion: A repair crew's stranded-vehicle call comes through. Iri sends their coordinates before the dust reaches the road.

title: Share the Network Keys
briefing: Divide the Relay terminal's master access between district, roadside, accessibility, and maintenance delegates. The charter must also bar loans secured against the fen or steppe.
completion: Iri keeps a mechanic's key. The rejected collateral deal leaves three bridges without repair funding; she posts their names.

title: Shut Down the Toll Chain
briefing: The outer toll wardens are still executing their final order. Disable them while the stewards broadcast the expiry record.
completion: The last barrier drops. A route crew checks the surface before letting the waiting carts through.

title: Reserve Batteries for Rescues
briefing: Reserve the Last salt beacon's batteries for distress calls and publish the fen's reduced water schedule. Scheduled carriers will have to wait for new cells.
completion: A stranded traveler's call gets through. Three carriers miss their slots. Iri logs the rescue and the delays together.

title: Check the Falling Water Level
briefing: Walk the reopened route to the Fen drawdown gauge. Iri needs a fresh reading before the stewards set next month's crossings and water deliveries.
completion: The gauge is lower. Iri posts rationed crossings and turns down an offer to buy priority access. The repair fund has enough for another month.

title: Save the Shutoff Notice
briefing: The kitchen’s water donors have been billed again. Collect Oru’s welcome record, read the notice at the Commons exchange, then help restore the feed. Keep the original notice at the Memory vault.
completion: The feed is running, and the notice is saved as evidence. Return to Oru, then ask Nella about the diners missing from her tally.

story.speaker: sera
story.invitation: I am Sera Quill, beside the Commons. The kitchen has been charged for water its neighbors already donated. Come speak with me. We need a witness, and a working feed.

title: Withdraw the Unlicensed Recording
briefing: A commercial catalog is using a resident's lullaby recording without permission. Check the release at the Memory vault. The melody can stay public; the singer's voice cannot.
completion: The recording is withdrawn. The neighborhood keeps the tune and credits its singer.

title: Close the Expired Diary Copy
briefing: A diary's permission seal expired after one winter. Retrieve the dated instruction from the Public memory archive and close the open copy.
completion: The diary returns to its intended readers. Its expiry date is visible on the access panel.

title: Stop the Voiceprint Collectors
briefing: Audit drones are taking voiceprints from the memory clinic queue. Disable their recorders before another patient is scanned.
completion: Sera seals the damaged recorders for evidence. She does not play them back.

title: Check the Bird Survey
briefing: The vault sells a recording of birds returning to Mourning Fen. Compare the field record at the drawdown gauge with its source file.
completion: The calls came from a sales library. Sera marks the species absent and files the unedited survey beside the advertisement.

title: Protect a Witness’s Privacy
briefing: A stallholder's lift-accident testimony includes a private family argument. Post the safety account at the Commons exchange with that section removed.
completion: The lift inspection is ordered. The witness checks the public version and asks Sera to keep the original sealed.

title: Stop Deleted Files Being Restored
briefing: Salvage machines are restoring files whose owners requested deletion. Disable the recovery units before they make more copies.
completion: The recovery queue stops. Sera takes the machine log for the deletion hearing.

title: Make Consent Controls Accessible
briefing: The Memory vault hides withdrawal controls three menus deep. Fit a panel showing who has access, for what purpose, and for how long.
completion: A visitor changes her permissions without calling Sera over. She leaves the panel open for the next person.

title: Separate the Merged Records
briefing: Two residents share a birth date and a former address. The Public memory archive has merged their records. Split them and keep a correction trail.
completion: Their appointments separate. So do their debts; one resident immediately asks for a second correction.

title: Meet the Forest Witness
briefing: A witness to Cinderwood's false restoration accounts will meet only at the Canopy refuge. Check the approach for company recorders.
completion: The approach is clear. The witness signs a limited release, then asks what happens to the pension fund holding those certificates.

title: Require Permission Before Access
briefing: The Memory vault turns unanswered requests into permission after a timeout. Change the default so a record stays closed until its owner answers.
completion: Sera leaves the test request unanswered. The seal stays shut.

title: Prepare the Lift Inquiry
briefing: Prepare the lift-failure inquiry at the Public memory archive using machine logs and testimony witnesses have released. Keep disputed points marked.
completion: The evidence is enough to order repairs. The report lists the questions the inquiry still cannot answer.

title: Reopen Record Withdrawals
briefing: An archive warden is blocking valid withdrawals under the old access rules. Disable its lock controls so the clinic can honor them.
completion: The owners regain access to their records. Sera adds the warden's order to the policy appeal.

title: Verify Sera’s Missing Week
briefing: The Memory vault claims to hold Sera's missing week. Verify the shard's origin without opening it, and check the public financing record separately.
completion: The shard is authentic and remains sealed. Its purchase was funded by Cinderwood restoration certificates. Sera asks for a copy of that entry.

title: Publish the Care Charter
briefing: Post the Covenant charter's missing section at the Commons exchange: residents can receive care without keeping an archive or surrendering personal records.
completion: Residents add corrections beneath the notice. Sera schedules a review before filing the signed copy.

title: Find the Missing Caskets
briefing: Inspect the shipping route at the South floodgate. A manifest lists memory caskets left outside Vesper during the evacuation.
completion: Their destination was temporary storage. Sera starts tracing the delivery orders before arranging retrieval.

title: Copy the Casket Instructions
briefing: Copy the recovered caskets' consent seals into the Last salt beacon's protected register. The original labels will not survive the heat.
completion: The seals have a durable copy and a custody record. The caskets stay closed during transport.

title: Respect Refused Revivals
briefing: Survey the caskets near the Last freshwater seep whose occupants declined revival. Find a retrieval path that avoids the proposed blanket sterilization.
completion: A narrow route is marked. Some caskets cannot be reached in time; their refusal records are copied before the crew withdraws.

title: Stop the Casket Scanners
briefing: Index drones are scanning the recovered caskets for voices. Disable them before the recordings reach the public catalog.
completion: The upload queue is stopped. Sera preserves the request list, with the voices sealed.

title: Keep Both Witness Accounts
briefing: At the Public memory archive, file two authorized accounts of Cinderwood's expansion beside the payroll and water records. One witness fed a family there; the other lost a spring.
completion: The payroll and stump totals support both witnesses. Sera retains both accounts without merging their conclusions.

title: Protect the Casket Cooling
briefing: Wirejacks are cutting cooling jackets off the casket transport. Clear the collectors before the temperature rises past the safe limit.
completion: The cooling circuit holds. The keepers continue checking one consent seal at a time.

title: Publish the Anonymous Warning
briefing: A recovered witness released a safety report but withheld their name. Publish it through the Memory vault without an identifying catalog entry.
completion: The engineers receive the warning. Sera checks the search index twice; the witness's name does not appear.

title: Reduce Archive Cooling
briefing: Post the reduced storage plan at the Commons exchange. It funds clinic cooling by closing advertising and some immersive archives, instead of selling patient memories.
completion: Patients keep their records private. The virtual forest closes, leaving a transcript. Its donor cancels the next payment.

title: Stop the Forced Record Copies
briefing: Continuance has invoked an emergency exception to copy sealed records. Disable the wardens' extraction hardware while Sera challenges the unsigned order.
completion: The seals hold. The extraction log points to a replication service called the Inference Annex.

title: Investigate the Profile Service
briefing: Find the Inference Annex's mandate at the Public memory archive. It rebuilds withdrawn histories from public traces, then sells household profiles to water suppliers.
completion: Sera's deletion order covers the derived profiles as well as their source copies. The suppliers contest the order before the ink dries.

title: Install Independent Consent Checks
briefing: Install independent consent checks at the Memory vault. Auditors need to see rule violations without opening the records themselves.
completion: The first audit flags an expired permission. Sera cannot override the seal with her own key.

title: Stop the Backup Drones
briefing: Inference drones are carrying unauthorized profiles to roadside backups. Stop them before the copies disappear into the basin.
completion: The replica list stops growing. Sera sends the deletion order to every remaining address.

title: Register the Deletion Receipt
briefing: Register the last Annex deletion receipt at the Last salt beacon. Preserve the authority and time of deletion, without retaining the deleted records.
completion: The beacon accepts the receipt. A search of the replica returns an empty directory.

title: Shut Down the Inference Annex
briefing: Annex wardens are enforcing an order to preserve everything forever. Disable their extraction chassis while the keepers revoke that order.
completion: The Annex shuts down. Protected public records remain available through the ordinary vault controls.

title: Witness Sera’s Decision
briefing: Sera has made a decision about the missing week. Witness the Memory vault's permission check; leave the contents to Sera.
completion: The seal changes under Sera's key. In the next room, keepers sort records for the reduced cooling allowance.

title: Publish the Storage Losses
briefing: File the consent charter and the archive's actual water budget at Cinderwood's Stump ledger. Include the records being lost to low-power storage.
completion: The Annex is closed. Several immersive records survive only as text. Sera labels the empty shelf with the loss date and the cooling budget that forced it.

title: Restore the Kitchen Pump
briefing: The pump works, but an account lock has stopped the kitchen water. Get Oru’s welcome record and read the job notice at the Commons exchange. Restore the feed, then register the repair at the Public forge.
completion: The pump is steady and the repair is logged. Return to Oru, then ask Nella why the kitchen keeps receiving these bills.

steps.voice: Restore the kitchen water feed: repair both controls, clear enforcement, and hold the meter.

steps.voice: Record the bypass repair at the public forge. Press E, then return to Bram.

story.speaker: bram
story.invitation: You there, runner. Bram Cinder. Kitchen pump is sound; lock on the feed is not. Come to my marker. We have work to do.

title: Replace the Cracked Bracket
briefing: Three departments have stamped the cracked bracket. None has replaced it. Register a replacement pattern at the Public forge so Bram's crew can finish the job.
completion: The new bracket holds. Bram leaves the cracked one on the desk with all three stamps attached.

title: Set Relief Shifts
briefing: The pump crew's emergency rota has repeated for six months. Post relief shifts and protected breaks at the Commons exchange.
completion: The night crew clocks out. Their replacements get written handover notes and a working kettle.

title: Recover the Repair Tools
briefing: Wirejacks are taking tools from an active water-line repair because the department was dissolved. Disable the collectors.
completion: The crew recovers its tools. Bram puts the current maintainers' names on the rack.

title: Inspect the Overloaded Bridge
briefing: Inspect the Transit observatory span. Freight loads have been added to a bridge built for pedestrians, and the lower deck is reporting cracks.
completion: The stress marks match the freight timetable. Bram books an inspection with the residents beneath the span.

title: End the Heating Cutoffs
briefing: The district heater cuts off homes with disputed bills. Change its control plate at the Public forge and post the fuel source beside the access rules.
completion: The cutoffs stop. Bram reads the woodpile estimate and schedules a separate meeting about the shortfall.

title: Protect the Safety Stop
briefing: Audit drones restart machinery after workers hit the safety stop. Disable them before the crew opens the jammed feed assembly.
completion: The assembly stays still. The crew removes a bent gear with both hands clear of the drive.

title: Copy the Pump Schematics
briefing: Retrieve the pump schematics from the Public memory archive. The only technician who knows the sequence has not had a day off in months.
completion: She corrects three errors in the drawing. Bram copies the corrections for the apprentices and approves her leave.

title: Recover Waste Heat
briefing: The pipe marked waste carries enough residual heat for two clinics. Register a pressure-limited exchanger at the Public forge.
completion: Both clinics receive heat. Downstream pressure stays within the marked limits.

title: Check the True Fuel Cost
briefing: Check Cinderwood's Stump ledger. Bram's fuel estimate leaves out lost shade, drying soil, and the cutters' treatment debts.
completion: With those costs included, the current bids fail. Bram cuts output. The cutters lose overtime first.

title: Inspect the Sinking Foundations
briefing: Read the Fen drawdown gauge before Bram approves another foundation patch. The supports are settling as the intake drains the bank.
completion: The dates match. Reinforcing the towers would leave the intake drawing at the same rate; Bram holds the purchase order.

title: Open the Pressure Valve
briefing: A debt warden is blocking the emergency pressure valve. Shut it down so the engineers can open the relief line.
completion: The pressure drops into the safe band. The crew finishes the shift without a rupture.

title: Share the Spare Parts
briefing: Open the shared spare-parts register at the Public forge. Neighboring towers have compatible parts locked in separate stores.
completion: One tower's spare valve restarts another's pump. Both crews sign the replenishment sheet.

title: End Inherited Repair Debts
briefing: Find the original maintenance bond at the Public memory archive. Continuance is billing contractors' descendants for repairs they never agreed to perform.
completion: The bond names no consenting successor. Bram prepares releases for the workers and their families.

title: Publish the Maintenance Charter
briefing: Publish the Common Load charter at the Commons exchange: rotating shifts, paid recovery, open budgets, and the right to stop unsafe work.
completion: Bram signs the same form as the crew. The removal procedure applies to his post too.

title: Check the Excess Pumping
briefing: Read the Concession sluice. Separate clinic cooling from the extraction scheduled to pay private dividends.
completion: The dividend schedule keeps pumping after the tanks fill. Canceling it helps, but clinic demand alone still exceeds summer recharge.

title: Recalibrate the Fen Gauge
briefing: Recalibrate the Fen drawdown gauge to include recharge and the pump families' own water reserve.
completion: The revised report shows a deficit on ordinary days. Bram takes it to the assembly without changing the baseline.

title: Recover the Cooling Fins
briefing: Wirejacks are stripping passive cooling fins needed for the intake conversion. Clear the collectors so the crews can recover the usable parts.
completion: The sound fins reach the site. Bram rejects a stack of cracked ones despite the shortage.

title: Reduce the Furnace Schedule
briefing: Set a slower furnace schedule at the Public forge. Reserve clinic power and cut commercial peaks first; list the paid shifts that will be lost.
completion: Upper-deck lights dim. The crew gets shorter shifts and a temporary wage guarantee. Next month's funding is still blank.

title: Survey the New Heat Outlet
briefing: Survey the Glassroot soil core before approving the new heat outlet. The proposed vent crosses root beds, and its hardware draws from Ada's mineral seam.
completion: The smaller outlet spares the roots but cools fewer rooms. Bram adds the waiting households to the revised plan.

title: Add Accessible Shutdown Alarms
briefing: Connect the intake shutdown alarm to the Quiet array's light and vibration channels. Workers need to recognize it through masks, noise, or hearing loss.
completion: The crew identifies every signal in the test. The instructions go up beside each station.

title: Plan the Turbine Replacement
briefing: Trace the turbine surcharge at the Public memory archive. Prepare a retirement plan using a smaller replacement that leaves the Glassroot root mat intact.
completion: The turbine's repair costs exceed its useful reserve. The replacement covers essential loads; the remaining demand stays on the ration sheet.

title: Stop the Automatic Restarts
briefing: Audit drones keep restarting the turbine during conversion tests. Disable their restart network.
completion: The turbine remains idle. The replacement holds its rated load for the full test hour.

title: Separate Procedures from Private Memories
briefing: The turbine contract stores workers' memories as operating instructions. At the Memory vault, release authorized procedures and return control of private recollections.
completion: The engineers receive the procedures. Former crew members get separate notices asking what else, if anything, they wish to release.

title: Set Bridge Freight Limits
briefing: Inspect freight limits and pedestrian access at the Transit observatory before foundation materials cross the span.
completion: Freight gets scheduled slots. The pedestrian lane stays open throughout the conversion.

title: Free the Compulsory Shift
briefing: Turbine wardens are seizing workers for a compulsory final shift. Disable their restraints while delegates register the bond's termination.
completion: The workers are released. Enough sign up for the paid conversion shifts to cover the rota.

title: Test Overnight Cooling
briefing: Start the overnight cooling test at the Public forge. Prioritize clinics and exposed homes, and publish the ration schedule and appeal address.
completion: The clinics hold temperature. Other rooms remain hot; Bram spends the rest of the shift reading appeals.

title: Secure the Retired Intake
briefing: Wirejacks are swarming the retired intake. Clear the perimeter so trained crews can isolate hazardous sections before salvage begins.
completion: The safe metal goes into the common reserve. The contaminated chambers are sealed and marked.

title: Use the Remote Shutdown
briefing: The last wardens insist on a worker inside the shutdown chamber. Disable them so the crew can use its remote release.
completion: The turbine stops with everyone outside. Bram counts the crew twice before signing off.

title: Measure the Remaining Drawdown
briefing: Read the Fen drawdown gauge after the conversion. Report recharge, ground settlement, and the cooling demand the new system cannot meet.
completion: Local drawdown has slowed. The deeper bore is still falling. Bram postpones a workshop roof to fund another reading.

title: Survey Fuel After the Shutdown
briefing: Visit Cinderwood's Canopy refuge after the shutdown. Bram needs a fuel survey before deciding how the smaller furnace will handle the next heatwave.
completion: The canopy survives another season. Bram takes his first scheduled day off. An extraction lender's offer is waiting on his desk when he returns.

title: Restore the Kitchen Warning
briefing: Nella’s kitchen lost its water without a usable warning. Get Oru’s welcome record, read the notice at the Commons exchange, and help restore the feed. Then register the warning at the Quiet array.
completion: The water is running and the warning is registered. Return to Oru, then speak to Nella west of the exchange about the missed meals.

story.speaker: ves
story.invitation: Welcome. I am Ves. Find me by the Commons. The kitchen needs water, and a warning people can hear. We can begin quietly.

title: Add a Broadcast Countdown
briefing: The Quiet array starts its morning bulletin without warning. Add a visible countdown and a published schedule.
completion: The warning lamp comes on before the speakers. Residents have time to leave or switch channels.

title: Check the Listening Fines
briefing: Fetch the attention contract from the Public memory archive. Continuance is fining residents who do not acknowledge broadcasts.
completion: The contract covers staffed emergency posts. Someone extended it to bedrooms; Ves marks the amendment and its signer.

title: Stop the Pursuing Loudspeakers
briefing: Audit drones follow residents who leave a broadcast, repeating it louder. Shut down the pursuing units.
completion: The drones stop. A resident reads the same bulletin from the noticeboard and goes home.

title: Mark the Route by Touch
briefing: Survey the handrails and landings at the Transit observatory. Spoken directions keep getting lost in the wind.
completion: The crew fits tactile and visible markers. A local walker tests the route before the old speakers come down.

title: Make the Bulletin Optional
briefing: Configure the Quiet array to offer a channel without opening nearby receivers. List the bulletin and let residents connect themselves.
completion: Receivers show the new channel. Those who select it hear the bulletin at the stated time.

title: Protect the Warning Lamps
briefing: Wirejacks are taking warning lamps while leaving the broken loudspeakers behind. Clear the collectors before the district loses its visible alarms.
completion: The lamps stay. The speakers go to the repair bench.

title: Withdraw the Announcer’s Voice
briefing: A former announcer's voice is still being used without permission. Check the release at the Memory vault and stop new announcements using that sample.
completion: The sample is withdrawn. Bulletins continue in the civic voice, with their transcripts intact.

title: Open the Community Noticeboard
briefing: The official phrasebook rejects complaints about the broadcast schedule. Open an attributed community board at the Commons exchange.
completion: The first notice complains about the Choir's meeting hour. Ves moves the meeting.

title: Trace the False Evacuation Alarm
briefing: Find the old evacuation alarm's trigger at the Public memory archive. Retrieve the housing advertisement attached to it as well.
completion: The expired alarm is switched off. The homes advertised on reclaimed wetland still need a current flood warning.

title: Survey the Quiet Forest Path
briefing: Survey a public path at Cinderwood's Canopy refuge. Amplified tours are disturbing the remaining nests, and the cutters rely on visitor income.
completion: The path opens without speakers, with a crowd limit. A tour company starts selling reservations for its own approach.

title: Separate Music and Quiet Areas
briefing: Set local listening zones at the Quiet array. Keep space for the market's musicians and a usable route to the quiet table.
completion: The crew tests both areas during a performance. Ves leaves the master mute control disabled.

title: Protect the Quiet-Zone Walls
briefing: A warden has ordered the quiet-zone walls demolished as an obstruction to broadcasts. Disable its demolition controls.
completion: The walls remain. The crew checks that the public notices are still visible from both sides.

title: Correct the Signed Testimony
briefing: The Public memory archive files signed testimony as unidentified movement. Correct the catalog with the interpreters' attributed transcripts and visual records.
completion: The testimony is searchable. The interpreters retain access to correct translation errors.

title: Publish the Listening Charter
briefing: Post the Listening Charter at the Commons exchange. Require accessible alternatives, named authors, emergency expiry dates, and an opt-out that preserves essential services.
completion: Ves signs it without an exemption for the Choir. The first review date is posted below.

title: Remove Private Recordings
briefing: Survey the recorder range at the Glassroot soil core. Its wilderness channel hides kiln alarms and includes recordings from Ada's home.
completion: The household recordings are removed and the alarm channel is restored. The unedited feed contains wind, grinding ceramic, and a cough.

title: Limit Emergency Bulletins
briefing: Separate weather and rescue traffic from the Last salt beacon's compulsory announcements. Give warnings a location, an action, and an expiry.
completion: The test bulletin ends on time. The beacon returns control to the receiver.

title: Withdraw the Childhood Sample
briefing: A Brine Bloom advertisement uses a resident's childhood voice without consent. Check the sample's release at the Memory vault.
completion: The resident gets the sample withdrawn. The company rerecords its recovery claim with a licensed speaker.

title: Stop the Mobile Repeaters
briefing: Broadcast drones follow travelers beyond the beacon's coverage zone. Disable the mobile repeaters.
completion: The travelers leave the channel behind. The fixed beacon continues carrying weather alerts.

title: Survey the Evacuation Route
briefing: Meet the evacuation survey at the Last freshwater seep. Record the residents' requested warning terms and the route out of the outer settlement.
completion: The board shows the exit and supply schedule. The residents ask for fewer broadcasts, not fewer deliveries.

title: Protect the Storm Lamps
briefing: Wirejacks are stripping the basin's storm-warning lamps. Clear the collection route before the dust front arrives.
completion: The lamp chain stays lit through the first grit. The same warning remains available in text and optional audio.

title: Make Opt-Outs Work
briefing: The Quiet array treats every opt-out as a fault and raises its power. Add a signed refusal signal, and reserve the nesting refuge's quiet interval.
completion: The array accepts the refusal without boosting output. Ves tests it again after a receiver restart.

title: Set Emergency Expiry Dates
briefing: The Public memory archive records when emergencies begin but never when they end. Require an expiry and a named reviewer for priority broadcasts.
completion: The next permanent-emergency request is rejected. Its author must supply a review date.

title: Disable the Amplifier Wardens
briefing: Wardens are raising amplifier power to override refusal signals. Shut down their controls while essential notices move to independent channels.
completion: The forced broadcast fades. The control ledger names its root order: universal attendance.

title: Revoke the Attendance Contract
briefing: Retrieve the universal-attendance template from the Public memory archive. Find the clause that treats receipt of a message as acceptance of a contract.
completion: There is no signature field. Ves drafts a revocation covering every faction's broadcasts.

title: Plan the Market Celebration
briefing: Post the market celebration schedule at the Commons exchange. Include performances, quiet periods, an accessible route home, and the water and power allowance.
completion: The dance floor opens beside the quiet route. The music ends early to stay within the reserve.

title: Clear the Storm Channel
briefing: Repeater drones are flooding the channel with demands to acknowledge universal attendance. Disable them before they bury the approaching storm notice.
completion: The weather bulletin gets through. Ves keeps one copy of the compulsory demand for the case file.

title: Save the Listening Settings
briefing: The Quiet array restores compulsory listening after a power loss. Save the districts' choices in local records and test recovery.
completion: The array restarts with the settings intact. Ves posts the recovery instructions beside the switch.

title: End Compulsory Broadcasts
briefing: The root wardens still enforce universal attendance after its authority has expired. Disable them while the keepers revoke the order across the network.
completion: The root channel closes with an end notice. No acknowledgment is requested.

title: Test the Accessible Warning
briefing: Test the Last salt beacon's final bulletin. Light, text, and optional voice must agree, then end on time. Keep the bloom evacuation boundary on the board.
completion: The test ends. A real distress call takes the freed channel while the crew checks the boundary markers.

title: Check the New Evacuation Boundary
briefing: Return to the Last freshwater seep after the beacon test. Check the withdrawal boundary and record which warning stations are still reachable.
completion: Ves stands beside the abandoned houses. Wind moves through a broken window; fungal fans have reached the next marker. The crew moves the warning board back.

title: Reserve a Welcome Meal
briefing: Nella’s kitchen has lost its water. Read the shutoff notice at the Commons exchange, help your contact restore the feed, then use the Lantern kitchen tally to reserve a meal for the next arrival. Bring the record back to me.
completion: Your meal is reserved, and there’s a portion set aside for the next arrival. Ask Nella why fourteen regular diners missed yesterday’s meal.

title: Correct the Shelter Census
briefing: Compare the shelter census with the kitchen records at the Public memory archive. Several children received meals but were never counted as residents.
completion: The cooks wrote the missing names on flour invoices. Oru adds them to the census with copies of the original records.

title: Compare Water and Survival Records
briefing: A pamphlet claims Afterborn survival came from ancestry. Compare the Fen drawdown gauge’s water records with shelter survival figures.
completion: Survival improved when the filters worked. Oru corrects the pamphlet and adds the current readings: the wetland is now supplying more water than it replaces.

title: End Clinic Ancestry Checks
briefing: Clinic drones reject patients whose family records have gaps. Disable two drones while the staff removes the ancestry check.
completion: Patients are admitted by medical need. Staff remove the unused ancestry fields from the admission form.

title: Read the Medic’s Account
briefing: Read the medic’s authorized account at the Memory vault. Keep the supply-sharing instructions and the entry about buying water from a company that displaced another shelter.
completion: Oru files the complete account. The instructions helped one shelter survive, while the water purchase contributed to another shelter’s eviction.

title: Survey Clinic Ventilation
briefing: Survey airflow at the Transit observatory. Lower clinics report more coughing when hot exhaust settles beneath the freight deck.
completion: The readings support a new vent and a shaded recovery route. Oru submits both repairs for funding.

title: Check the Old Shelter Route
briefing: Check Cinderwood’s Canopy refuge against the old mobile-kitchen route. Some marked rest stops have lost their shade.
completion: Several rest stops are bare. Oru marks them unsafe and moves the care route beneath the remaining canopy.

title: Post the Roadside Clinic Schedule
briefing: Post the roadside clinics’ visit times, water deliveries, and private request channel at the Last salt beacon. Keep patient names off the public board.
completion: The shelters receive the schedule. Private appointment requests go directly to the clinic.

title: Protect the Medicine Carrier
briefing: Disable four salvage machines before they strip the medicine carrier’s cooling packs.
completion: The medicine arrives within its safe temperature range. Oru schedules a relief crew for the next delivery.

title: Remove the Labor-Based Care Rule
briefing: Find the clinic’s labor forecast rule at the Public memory archive. Remove its treatment priorities and keep a record of the patients it delayed.
completion: The clinic stops ranking patients by expected earnings. Staff publish the remaining medicine shortage and contact people whose care was delayed.

title: Open Clinic Admissions
briefing: Disable two wardens enforcing the old labor forecast at clinic admissions. Staff are ready to replace it with a medical priority list that patients can appeal.
completion: The wardens stop collecting patients. The clinic posts its admission rules and an appeal contact by the door.

title: Publish the Care Budget
briefing: Publish the roadside clinics’ water allowance, staffing, and waiting list at the Last salt beacon. List the appointments the budget cannot yet cover.
completion: The care budget is public. A family asks when its delayed treatment will happen. The clinic cannot give them a date yet.

title: Measure Water for the Next Meal
briefing: Return to the Fen drawdown gauge and measure the supply before the next meal. The kitchen now accepts everyone, but still has a fixed water ration.
completion: The kitchen serves the first queue, then waits for another rationed delivery. Oru adds the reading and the number of people still waiting to the meal record.

title: Register Your Chosen Name
briefing: The welcome form asks for a factory serial before your name. First read the Commons exchange notice and help restore the kitchen water. Then use the Memory vault to record your chosen name and return to me.
completion: Your name appears first. The serial remains in a repair record you control. Nella is west of the exchange if you want to help with the missing meals.

title: Correct the Ceramic Repair Guide
briefing: Check the ceramic repair guide at the Public forge. Add a patient consent check and replace its claim of unlimited Glassroot stock with the actual inventory.
completion: The guide requires consent before a plate is replaced. The inventory now shows when the kiln will run out.

title: Compare the Two Memory Records
briefing: Compare the two authorized memory records at the Memory vault. They describe the same morning with different colors and distances.
completion: Different sensor calibrations explain the disagreement. Oru keeps both recordings with their calibration notes.

title: Stop the Body Recall
briefing: Disable two audit drones seizing Lattice bodies under a ceramic safety notice. Technicians can offer repairs once the collection route is clear.
completion: The safety warning stays on the board. The seizure order is removed, and technicians offer voluntary appointments.

title: Separate the Forked Citizens’ Records
briefing: Retrieve the separate declarations of two forked Lattice citizens at the Public memory archive. The census has merged their homes and repair appointments.
completion: Both records are restored. The kiln now needs to cover two repairs from a budget that allowed for one.

title: Fix Duplicate Identity Detection
briefing: Survey the Transit observatory repeater. It flags two forked citizens as duplicates whenever they cross the bridge.
completion: The repeater accepts their separate current keys. Both can cross without an identity warning.

title: Survey the Ceramic Mineral Seam
briefing: Survey the Glassroot soil core. The mineral used for replacement bodies also supports the roots around the settlement’s well.
completion: The deeper cut would supply ceramic but undermine the well. Oru files the repair demand beside the soil survey.

title: Retrieve Tam’s Housing Request
briefing: Retrieve Tam’s housing request from the Vacant land register. Compare its date with the mineral concession that displaced local families.
completion: Tam received a private room. The clay for that body came from land taken from another settlement. Oru keeps both records together.

title: Recover Occupied Mesh Plates
briefing: Disable four salvage machines collecting occupied mesh plates. Return recovered fragments to the repair crews.
completion: Identified plates return to their owners. Unidentified fragments stay in protected storage until someone can check them.

title: Require Consent for Memory Changes
briefing: At the Memory vault, require consent before a service removes conflicting recollections from your record.
completion: The service keeps both recollections and records your instruction. It can no longer choose one for deletion automatically.

title: Stop the Forced Mergers
briefing: Disable two wardens attempting to merge independently living Lattice forks. Archivists will register their separate declarations.
completion: The forced-merger equipment stops. Each resident receives a separate record for housing, care, and repairs.

title: Register Separate Repair Rights
briefing: Register the new Lattice charter at the Public memory archive. Protect separate identities and voluntary repairs, then publish the limited repair budget and appeal process.
completion: The charter is filed. The repair queue remains longer than the kiln’s current reserve can cover.

title: Close the Deeper Mineral Claim
briefing: Register the charter at the Vacant land register and close the deeper extraction claim. Future urgent repairs will use recovered ceramic.
completion: Ada patches another shell with recovered pieces. The deeper seam stays closed, and several repairs remain on the waiting list.

title: Record Your New Introduction
briefing: Use the name you want recorded now. Read the Commons exchange notice, help your contact restore the kitchen water, then leave your introduction at the Relay terminal. Bring the record back to me.
completion: The channel uses your current name. Your earlier name stays private unless you choose to share it. Nella needs help west of the exchange.

title: Return Control of the Letter
briefing: Check the waiting letter’s delivery seal at the Memory vault without opening it. Return control of it to the intended recipient.
completion: The recipient can open, answer, or leave the letter sealed. The vault cancels the automatic reunion appointment.

title: Find the Hidden Service Bond
briefing: Find the early revival forms at the Public memory archive. A service bond was hidden beneath the consent page.
completion: The signature authorized both restoration and compulsory work. Oru lists the living people still being charged under it.

title: Stop Body Repossession
briefing: Disable two audit drones issuing repossession orders from old contractor marks. The clinic can then remove those marks at each patient’s request.
completion: Patients reach the clinic without machine escorts. Removing an old mark no longer requires a contractor’s approval.

title: Adjust the Tool Grip
briefing: Adjust the Public forge’s controls for a worker whose restored hand has a different grip.
completion: The worker finishes the assembly using the adjusted controls. The new grip settings are saved for their next shift.

title: Correct the Revival Guide
briefing: Correct the revival guide at the Memory vault. Explain incomplete memories, possible body changes, and available follow-up care.
completion: The guide no longer guarantees an unchanged return. Patients can read the limits before signing.

title: Investigate the Barrier Rescue
briefing: Inspect the Fen drawdown gauge’s barrier-era records. Rescue supplies were diverted from the workers to paying cooling customers.
completion: The original schedule could have reached the barrier crew. The diversion delayed it; Oru adds the delivery orders to the incident record.

title: Recover the Delayed Rescue Log
briefing: Recover the delayed barrier rescue log at the Last salt beacon. Vehicles were held for an unpaid transport authorization.
completion: The log confirms the delay. Oru adds it to the challenge against the workers’ service debts.

title: Protect the Restoration Caskets
briefing: Disable four salvage machines cutting open dormant restoration caskets. Keep each casket sealed until its recorded instructions are checked.
completion: The caskets arrive intact. Staff check each person’s revival instructions before starting treatment.

title: Cancel the Inherited Service Debt
briefing: Publish the full service bond history at the Public memory archive. Cancel the inherited work debt without replacing it with a claim on the new body.
completion: The work debt is canceled. Restoration still requires funding, so the clinic opens a separate review of its water and materials budget.

title: Disable the Repossession Wardens
briefing: Disable two repossession wardens still collecting Revenants under the canceled bond.
completion: The collectors shut down. Clinics hand out release records without charging the affected patients.

title: Register New Revival Instructions
briefing: Register new revival instructions at the Memory vault. Both consent and refusal must be revocable. Include the current limits on water and cultivated bodies.
completion: The vault accepts either decision. It also states that shortages may delay a requested revival.

title: Publish the Nutrient Reserve
briefing: Register the corrected barrier history and new consent rules at the Sealed culture bank. Publish the actual nutrient reserve beside them.
completion: The service bond is retired. Restored patients owe no compulsory labor, but others remain in storage while water and cultures run short.

title: Record Your Care Needs
briefing: The welcome notice treats every symbiont as a hazard. First read the Commons exchange notice and help restore the kitchen water. Then use the Lantern kitchen tally to record individual care needs and return to me.
completion: The notice now asks what each person needs. Nella has enough water for tonight; ask her about the meals missed yesterday.

title: Test an Open Nutrient Recipe
briefing: Test the open nutrient recipe at the Public forge. Check its water and mineral requirements before it replaces the licensed formula.
completion: The tested recipe can be copied freely. The mixer lists which cultures it supports and how much water each batch needs.

title: Recover the Miners’ Notes
briefing: Recover the miners’ cultivation notes at the Public memory archive. The company account credits only its laboratory.
completion: The notes document years of experiments by miners. Oru adds their names and methods to the public history.

title: Stop Culture Seizures
briefing: Disable two salvage machines seizing living symbiont cultures as company stock.
completion: The clinic moves its patients and samples safely. Staff retain the seizure orders as evidence.

title: Correct the Symbiont Diaries
briefing: Read the released Sporebound diaries at the Memory vault. Correct the catalog’s claim that chemical signals are commands from a hive mind.
completion: The revised entries describe separate hosts and cultures. One diarist reduced a culture’s growth because it was making breathing difficult.

title: Check the Clinic Vent
briefing: Survey the Transit observatory’s airflow before the clinic opens a new culture-room vent. Keep experimental spores off the public walkway.
completion: The crew chooses a filtered outlet. Ordinary Sporebound residents keep access to the walkway.

title: Survey the Spreading Fungus
briefing: Survey the Last freshwater seep and compare the fungal spread with the supplier’s recovery claims. Record the homes and native plants lost along the boundary.
completion: The fungus is spreading while households leave and native plants die. Oru files the survey beside the company’s advertisement.

title: Trace the Culture’s Water Use
briefing: Check the Sealed culture bank’s mineral records. Licensed cultures need the supplier’s feed; escaped strains have started drawing directly from the seep.
completion: The escaped strains no longer need the licensed feed. Their water use leaves less for the refuge cultures.

title: Stop Blanket Sterilization
briefing: Disable four treatment drones spraying sterilant across the refuges. Their spray kills protected cultures as well as the escaped strain.
completion: The spray stops. The clinic begins targeted removal and sealed trials instead.

title: Test Contained Cultures
briefing: Test mixed cultures in a sealed bioreactor at the Public forge. Measure their water use and waste heat as well as their effect on the escaped strain.
completion: One mixture slows the strain, but uses too many nutrients for a basin-wide release. The keepers reserve it for contained refuges.

title: Remove the Biased Checkpoint
briefing: Disable two wardens blocking Sporebound travelers while admitting unsealed company samples. Inspectors are ready to check exposure and packaging instead of ancestry.
completion: Travelers regain access. The unsealed sample crates are held for inspection.

title: Open the Sealed Culture Library
briefing: Register a sealed culture library and its water allowance at the Sealed culture bank. Mark the refuge boundary and the supplies available for households that must move.
completion: The library opens with a fixed allowance. Families beyond the boundary receive relocation notices and supplies.

title: Check the Refuge Boundary
briefing: Return to the Last freshwater seep after the trials. Check the refuge markers and record any growth beyond them.
completion: The culture lease has ended and the refuge jars remain sealed. Wild fungus continues across the evacuated houses, so the keepers move the outer markers back.

title: Compare Pumping and Wages
briefing: Mara's overtime pays for water from the company draining her father's well. Read the Fen drawdown gauge so she can compare extraction with her shift records.
completion: The steepest drops match the best-paid shifts. Mara lays the overtime slips beside the readings.

title: Check the Proposed Share Payment
briefing: The concession is offering shares instead of back pay. Retrieve the contract at the Concession sluice before Mara's crew signs.
completion: The shares carry no vote. Their dividend rises when pumping exceeds the wetland limit. Mara takes the contract back to the crew.

title: Record the Winter Pumping Limit
briefing: Record Mara's settlement at the Concession sluice: lower extraction and a winter wage floor, paid for by canceling the dividend. The lease can resume after the guarantee expires.
completion: The pump slows. Mara can buy water through winter. The gauge remains well below its old high-water stain.

title: Check the False Forestry Credits
briefing: Check the Stump ledger west of Vesper. Tovin's restoration crew is being paid to cut living trees, with replacement seedlings already sold as mature timber.
completion: Most seedlings died in their first dry season. The nursery photograph on every certificate is eleven years old.

title: Survey the Remaining Canopy
briefing: Survey the soil at the Canopy refuge. Cutting the last shade trees would clear Tovin's treatment debt and expose the surviving seedlings to the heat.
completion: The shaded soil still holds water. Outside the canopy, roots crumble. Tovin's daughter's next treatment bill arrives that afternoon.

title: Cancel the False Timber Certificates
briefing: Enter the cutters' actual yield and treatment debts at the Stump ledger. They will share the surviving wood and sell fallen timber, canceling the false restoration credits.
completion: The certificates collapse, taking the crew's pension reserve with them. Tovin sells his tools to keep his daughter's appointment. The living trees remain standing.

title: Measure the Mineral Seam
briefing: Read the Glassroot soil core before Ada authorizes a deeper cut. Her partner needs replacement ceramic; the same seam supports the roots around the settlement's well.
completion: The deeper seam could supply years of repairs. Removing it would collapse the well within months. Ada asks to see the measurements again.

title: Correct the Vacant Land Survey
briefing: Retrieve the mine survey from the Vacant land register. It lists the settlement as vacant, although Ada's neighbors are still living there.
completion: The surveyor recorded every house, then removed them from the valuation. The company offers the residents relocation loans.

title: Register the Settlement’s Relocation
briefing: Register the settlement's departure at the Vacant land register and close the deeper extraction claim. The relocation grant carries no debt; salvaged ceramic will cover urgent repairs only.
completion: Ada loads her partner's patched shell onto a handcart. The families leave with a right to return and no date when they can use it.

title: Measure the Shared Seep
briefing: Inspect the Last freshwater seep before the spreading fungus reaches the refuge cultures. Ilex needs a water reading, not another photograph for the recovery prospectus.
completion: Licensed cultures and escaped strains are drawing from the same seep. The outer houses are already empty.

title: Challenge the Culture Lease
briefing: Read the oldest lease at the Sealed culture bank. Continuance still charges hosts for propagating their partners even though the original owner is gone.
completion: The licensed strain depends on the supplier's scarce feed. Escaped descendants draw straight from the seep. Ilex records both in the lease challenge.

title: Register the Containment Plan
briefing: Register Ilex's containment plan at the Sealed culture bank. Cancel the propagation lease, seal the culture library, and withdraw the outer settlement with its remaining supplies.
completion: The bank closes its sales desk. Growth covers the evacuated houses. Ilex leaves one lamp burning for the next inspection.

title: Find the Missing Diners
briefing: Fourteen bowls stayed empty yesterday. Your repair brought the water back, but it did not bring those people home. Start at the Lantern kitchen tally. Compare it with the Commons water meter, then return to the tally and save the names. I need the people, runner, not a better-looking total.
completion: Fourteen names. Thank you. We keep their bowls here. Now we need to find out why a donated jug costs its donor another payment. I have the next job ready for you.

completion: Same serial, two charges. There is our proof. The kitchen is running again, but I cannot stand at that meter all night. One more job: help us share the work.

completion: There. Someone else has the ladle. The portions are still small, but no one gets billed twice for sharing. You know this block now, runner. Your faction contact has more work when you are ready.

title: Check the Rejected Memory
briefing: Visit the Unsorted witness shelf. Elin needs to know whether the discarded record was unwanted, or merely unprofitable. Compare both marked records, then return to the first to preserve what disagrees.
completion: The witness wanted that morning kept. A clerk places the request beside its disposable label and waits for an explanation.

title: Trace the Missed Flood Warning

completion: The assembly reads the missed advisory in silence. Sable adds accessible warning endpoints to the unfinished work.

title: Test the Lamp and Handrail
briefing: Test the Tactile warning relay and inspect its failure indicator. A warning needs a way to tell people when it cannot warn them. The block is facing another emergency: a warning without sound. Read the service record, help resolve the live incident, then record the outcome.
completion: Neighbors check the pulses against the lamps. The failure light is added to the inspection sheet, not hidden beneath a successful demonstration.

briefing: Register the inspection rota at the Listening Courts noticeboard. Keep the accessible warning public and the court voluntarily quiet. Put the rota into practice: publish it, spend ten seconds monitoring the service, then confirm the handover on the board.
completion: The lamps begin their inspection cycle. Caretakers return to the planters; two names remain on the board for the next battery check.

title: Count the Night Passengers
briefing: Visit the Night platform register. Ivo needs the names of the people who used the supposedly empty service. Compare both marked records, then return to the first to preserve what disagrees.
completion: Forty names fill the departure sheet. Commuters compare the list with the zero on the closure notice.

steps.text: Reach the first neighborhood record.
Compare the service record with the first account.
Return to the first record and preserve the discrepancy.

title: Check the Service-Pass Exclusion
briefing: Read the Service-pass counter. Trace where the cleaners and carers disappear from the passenger total. The block is facing another emergency: the last lift is closing. Read the service record, help resolve the live incident, then record the outcome.
completion: Ivo posts the exclusion rule beside the board. The mechanic starts checking the late lift while the workers negotiate its hours.

steps.text: Read the service record before intervening.
Restore both incident controls, clear enforcement, and hold the marked site.
Record the restored service and who was left waiting.

title: Keep the Late Connection Open
briefing: Publish the staffed late-lift rota at the Last Connection duty board. Count service passengers and name the relief crew. Put the rota into practice: publish it, spend ten seconds monitoring the service, then confirm the handover on the board.
completion: The late lift keeps its crew. There are fewer connections than the workers wanted, but the final one has a published time and someone responsible for keeping it.

steps.text: Publish the neighborhood rota.
Monitor the service in person
Confirm the handover on the duty board.
